summary: Concentrated: 40 holdings, but the top ten are 74% of the portfolio.
Trades a lot: about 40% of the portfolio changes in a year.
The average holding, by value, has been owned for at least 3.4 years.
Compared with the typical S&P 500 company, its holdings are cheaper.
Copying each filing beat the S&P 500 in 3 of 9 full years.

profile.background: Born in 1947, son of the baseball player Hank Greenberg. Co-founded Chieftain Capital in 1984 with John Shapiro and started Brave Warrior Advisors after they split in 2009.
profile.approach: Concentrated value: rarely more than ten companies, each at least 5% of the portfolio, demanding a high return on the price paid.
known: Chieftain returned about 18% a year from 1984 to 2009 against the market's 12% (before fees).
Was hurt by the collapse of Valeant in 2015–16.

name: Glenn Greenberg
